scope: Under strict-live Fano correctness, W≤2, empty gate-output support and empty opposite-operand support, the remaining operand support has at most two labels. No minimality or quietness conclusion.
checks: Two carried labels with a common neighbor have different other exits by support antichain.
The common neighbor has precisely the opposite of those exits as its two slots.
Alternate neighbors of the two labels are on one bipartition side and nonadjacent; cover-free separation contradicts the exhausted common-neighbor slots.
Two distinct labels on the same Fano side always have a common neighbor, so side parity is injective on the operand support. Its cardinality is at most two.
Post-review source repairs only reflect Adj into the finite Boolean adjacency before kernel decisions.
